class.name: DSCrypto
class.brief_description: Native cryptographic helpers used by the runtime installer.
class.description: Provides cryptographic primitives that Godot's scripting layer does not expose, starting with SHA-512 over a file. SHA-512 is the hash NuGet publishes for package integrity through [code]packageHash[/code]; [HashingContext] only offers MD5, SHA-1 and SHA-256. On Windows the digest is computed with CNG (bcrypt); on other platforms [method sha512_file] returns an empty array because the DirectStorage runtime installer is Windows-only. Publisher-identity checks (Authenticode) can be added here later without changing the installer API.

method.name: sha512_file
method.description: Returns the raw 64-byte SHA-512 digest of [param path]. Returns an empty array when the file cannot be read or no SHA-512 backend is available.
